explanation: Both controlled reference computations failed at the input-loading statement, and the test allowance is now exhausted before a passing offline run could be recorded. Evidence: (1) neurokit2 0.2.13 nk.data() prepends the GitHub path prefix (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neuropsychology/NeuroKit/master/data/) to any argument lacking the literal substring "https" and then calls pd.read_csv() remotely, so a plain local path cannot be loaded offline (reference test 1, DNS resolution failure at analysis.py line 38). (2) Prepending a fake scheme ("https:/work/cache/...") is rejected by urllib ("no host given") because pandas treats the colon as a URL scheme (reference test 2). (3) The working, verified offline form is a local path whose leaf filename contains "https" without a colon: nk.data() then passes the argument verbatim to pd.read_csv(), and pandas' is_url() returns False so the staged file is read locally — confirmed by focused import/inspection and a direct read of the staged bytes by the reference environment (30000 rows, columns ECG/PPG/RSP). The byte-identical source input was fetched and verified (sha256 6a33ff8ae229f608354563044ff4a4d1c4e927c817e9269a4dec6173abefc385; identical at the pinned notebook revision ff419d9 and master), and both reference attempts hash-verified the staged inputs. The submitted recipe files now carry the verified form, but because they do not match a successful controller test (both dispatches failed at the unchanged data-loading statement, before any HRV computation ran), no tested outcome can be claimed. No exports were produced and no scientific values were ever computed in any run, so nothing beyond the blocked data path was validated; the HRV computations themselves remain unexecuted and unverified. Dependency install, environment resolution and input staging all succeeded in both attempts (28 packages resolved and installed offline-capable; the only failure is the nk.data remote-prefix routing). A single additional reference dispatch using the current files should fully execute the analysis, but no test allowance remains.
